title: refactor(collaboration, types)!: retire the zero-consumer useMentionNotifications hook and MentionNotification
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb8SWuZMeMAGh31P7H2NJ3R7)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is one batch of it.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删除 `@object-ui/collaboration` 里没有任何使用者的 `useMentionNotifications` 钩子(连同两个配置/结果类型),以及 `@object-ui/types` 里只被它读取的 `MentionNotification` 接口。
- 为什么改:控制台的 @提及 铃铛读的是服务端通知(`sys_notification`,经 `useInboxBell`),这个前端内存版钩子从未被接上;留着它会让人(和 AI)误以为提及通知走的是它。
- 风险与回滚:对外是 breaking 收窄,只影响直接 import 这几个名字的外部宿主;仓内与 hotcrm 零引用。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.changeset/25921-collab-mention-notifications.md`(迁移说明)、`ui/packages/types/src/views.ts`(删除的接口)、`ui/packages/collaboration/src/index.ts`(barrel 行)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -w -e useMentionNotifications -e MentionNotification -- ui packages apps examples content` 应只剩 changeset 与 QA 清单里的历史文字,无代码命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- Delete `ui/packages/collaboration/src/useMentionNotifications.ts` (97 lines) and its barrel lines (`useMentionNotifications`, `MentionNotificationsConfig`, `MentionNotificationsResult`).
- Delete the `MentionNotification` interface from `ui/packages/types/src/views.ts` and its barrel line in `ui/packages/types/src/index.ts`.
- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/record-id-string-survivors-10078.test.ts`: doc comment only. It named `MentionNotification.recordId` while recounting which ids an earlier ruling covered; it now describes that interface as retired. The test pins `RecordSubscription.recordId` and `DataSourceMutationEvent.id` only, so no assertion moves.
- One new changeset, `.changeset/25921-collab-mention-notifications.md`: patch for both packages, BREAKING paragraph, one FROM/TO line per retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired ...)` naming all four operands.

| `MentionNotificationsConfig` | 2 | none |
| `MentionNotificationsResult` | 2 | none |
| `MentionNotification` | 4 | `ui/packages/types` definition, barrel and the 10078 test comment only |
| `useRealtimeSubscription` (positive control) | 72 | 71 |

hotcrm and docs.objectos.ai: 0 hits for `MentionNotification` (case-insensitive substring). No string or dynamic `import()` of the module path, and neither package README names the hook or the type.

After the change (head 4d64f54c). Two later merges of main brought no file of `collaboration` or `types`: d6bab300 none under `ui/`, 9be84e1e only `ui/packages/fields` (lookup cell). Readings:

- `vitest run packages/collaboration/ packages/types/ --maxWorkers=2` from `ui/`: Test Files 394 passed (394), Tests 10545 passed (10545).
- Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`: a temporary probe in app-shell importing the retired names answered `TS2305 Module '"@object-ui/types"' has no exported member 'MentionNotification'` and `TS2305 ... '"@object-ui/collaboration"' has no exported member 'useMentionNotifications'`, while `CommentEntry` from the same entry still resolved. Probe deleted.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:readme-exports`: census line `0 fabricated, 0 stale omission(s)`; exit 1 only on the known prerequisite (`packages/cli` dist unbuilt: `@object-ui/cli` imports `serve` / `init`).
- On 9be84e1e the census reads `MentionNotificationsConfig` 0, `MentionNotificationsResult` 0, `MentionNotification` 0, `useMentionNotifications` 1 (the QA checklist prose), control `useRealtimeSubscription` 72.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` L3265 (a `source[]` line saying the hook "is exported but the console does not consume it") is now stale: the hook is no longer exported. Left untouched per the claim's file surface; L3299 is a history row and stays as written.
- The pending precedent changeset `.changeset/25921-types-comment-search-result.md` says `MentionNotification` "stay[s] exported unchanged". This PR makes that sentence untrue for the release that consumes both. Not edited here (editing a pending `25921-*` changeset reds Check Changeset); the seat may want to amend it in a docs-only follow-up before the release.
- A director contract review is owed (narrowing batch); the seat routes it.
